title.en: From below: the Phules and nineteenth-century reform
title.hi: नीचे से सुधार: फुले दंपति और उन्नीसवीं सदी के सुधार आंदोलन

sources.name: NCERT Class 8, Our Pasts Part III, Chapter 7 'Women, Caste and Reform' (Reprint 2024-25)
sources.what: Rammohun Roy 1772-1833, Brahmo Sabha later Brahmo Samaj in Calcutta; scriptural method; sati banned 1829; Vidyasagar and the 1856 widow remarriage law; many reformers upper-caste; Phule born 1827, missionary schools, Aryan argument, Shudras and Ati Shudras to unite, Satyashodhak Samaj propagated caste equality; Gulamgiri 1873 dedicated to Americans who fought to free slaves; criticism of all inequality; continued by Ambedkar and Naicker; Brahmo Samaj formed 1830 (box); Arya Samaj 1875

sources.name: NCERT Class 12, Indian Society, Chapter 3 'Social Institutions: Continuity and Change' (Reprint 2026-27)
sources.what: Jotirao Phule 1827-1890, founded Satyashodhak Samaj (Truth Seekers Society) in 1873 for human rights and social justice of low castes; Savitribai Phule 1831-1897, first headmistress of the country's first school for girls in Pune, educated Shudras and Ati-Shudras, night school for agriculturists and labourers

sources.name: DD News (Prasar Bharati), 'PM Modi pays homage to Savitribai Phule on her birth anniversary', 3 January 2024
sources.what: In 1848 the Phules established a girls' school at Bhide Wada in Pune

sources.name: PIB, Ministry of Culture, 'Government of India Launches Nationwide Two-Year Commemoration of the 200th Birth Anniversary of Mahatma Jyotiba Phule', 11 April 2026
sources.what: Two-year commemoration from 11 April 2026 to 11 April 2028; High-Level Committee chaired by the Prime Minister

sources.name: PIB, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, 'Historic First: Nation Pays Tribute to Mahatma Jyotiba Phule at Parliament House on His 200th Birth Anniversary', 11 April 2026
sources.what: First-ever floral tributes to Phule inside Parliament premises at Prerna Sthal; describes year-long celebrations

sources.name: News On AIR, 'Maharashtra govt launches year-long initiatives to commemorate 200th birth anniversary of Mahatma Jyotirao Phule', 11 April 2026
sources.what: Maharashtra School Education Department year-long action plan in all schools from 11 April 2026: libraries as Knowledge Centres, books on Phule's life

q.en: In which year did Jotirao Phule write Gulamgiri?
q.hi: जोतीराव फुले ने गुलामगिरी किस साल लिखी?

why.en: Gulamgiri came in 1873, the same year as the Satyashodhak Samaj; 1829 was the sati ban and 1856 the widow remarriage law.
why.hi: गुलामगिरी अठारह सौ तिहत्तर में लिखी गई, उसी साल सत्यशोधक समाज बना; उनतीस सती पर रोक और छप्पन विधवा पुनर्विवाह कानून का साल है।

q.en: Savitribai Phule was the first headmistress of the country's first school for girls in which city?
q.hi: सावित्रीबाई फुले किस शहर में देश के पहले बालिका विद्यालय की पहली प्रधानाध्यापिका थीं?

why.en: The school opened in Pune in 1848, at Bhide Wada.
why.hi: यह स्कूल अठारह सौ अड़तालीस में पुणे के भिडे वाडा में खुला था।

q.en: To whom did Phule dedicate Gulamgiri?
q.hi: फुले ने गुलामगिरी किसे समर्पित की?

en: The Americans who fought to free slaves
hi: दासों को आज़ाद कराने के लिए लड़ने वाले अमेरिकी

why.en: He linked the condition of India's lower castes to slavery in America.
why.hi: वे भारत की निचली जातियों की हालत को अमेरिका की दास प्रथा से जोड़ रहे थे।

factsToCheck: Brahmo Sabha founding year 1828 (common in reference books and in the app's note) could not be opened in a primary source; script uses only NCERT Class 8's 'Brahmo Samaj, formed in 1830' and says Brahmo Sabha came first
1848 Bhide Wada school date rests on a DD News report, not NCERT; NCERT Class 12 confirms only 'first school for girls in Pune' without a year
Satyashodhak Samaj exact founding date (24 September 1873) not opened; script gives only the year 1873 (NCERT Class 12)

Commemoration length differs between PIB releases: Ministry of Culture says two years (11 April 2026 to 11 April 2028), Social Justice ministry says year-long; script states both and advises the safe line
Hindi script paraphrases the 2025 GS1 Q11 question because the official Hindi wording was not opened; English quotes it as in pyq.json
notes: Teaches the 'single renaissance' framing as a trap and the anti-caste strand as distinct; Phule's Aryan-invasion argument is presented as his argument, not as settled history. No Phule quotations used. Recent example: national bicentenary commemoration from 11 April 2026 (PIB) and Maharashtra school plan (News On AIR). Sources opened 20-21 November 2026.
